title: Fix: `cleanOrphanIpcDirs` Wire-Up with Live-PID Check
description: Priority fix for NO_GO task 150-028. Notes: cleanOrphanIpcDirs function updated: new sync API with live-PID check support (opts: { checkLivePid, minAgeMs }). Old async API preserved as cleanOrphanIpcDirsLegacy for backward compat. start.ts pre-flight wired with try/catch. Test file updated: legacy tests call cleanOrphanIpcDirsLegacy, 8 new tests added for live-PID check scenarios. All 42 scope tests pass (orphan-cleaner.test.ts + orphan-cleaner-ipc.test.ts + start-detached-fork.integration.test.ts). TSC clean for modified files. Pre-existing TSC errors in other files (observability-rotation.ts, feature-query.ts, sprint-finalizer.ts) are not from this task. Key design: minAgeMs=30s default prevents concurrent start race condition by protecting young IPC dirs without config.pid; dead PIDs (explicit 99999999) are always cleaned regardless of age.
